chapterInfo.content:
2
Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ atorofoɔ ne wɔn asotwe
1 # Mat 24.11; 1 Ti 4.1 Na adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ nso wɔ ɔman no mu, sɛdeɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ atorofoɔ bɛba mo mu nso. Wɔn na wɔde ɔsɛeɛ fekusɛm bɛba abɛhyɛ mu, na wɔapa Awurade a ɔtɔɔ wɔn na ɔgyee wɔn no mpo, na wɔde ɔsɛeɛ a ɛba ntɛmntɛm aba wɔn ho so. 2Na bebree bɛdi wɔn ahohwisɛm no akyi, na wɔn nti, wɔbɛka nokorɛ kwan no ho nsɛmmɔne. 3Na wɔnam anibereɛ so de nnaadaasɛm bɛpɛ mo ho mfasoɔ. Wɔn na ɛfiri tete wɔn atemmuo ntwentwɛn aseɛ, na wɔn sɛeɛ ntɔ nko.
4Na sɛ Onyankopɔn ankora abɔfoɔ a wɔyɛɛ bɔne no, na mmom ɔde esum kabii ahoma kyeree wɔn guu Asamando amanehunu bunu mu, sɛ wɔmfa wɔn nsie atemmuo a, 5#2 Pe 3.6; Gye 8.18 na sɛ wankora tete wiase no, na mmom Noa a ɔyɛ tenenee sɛnkafoɔ ne nnipa baason a wɔka ne ho na ɔgyee wɔn na ɔde nsuyire bɛkataa amumuyɛfoɔ wiase soɔ no, 6#Gye 19.25 na sɛ ɔdanee Sodom ne Gomora nkuro nso, na ɔde ɔsɛeɛ buu wɔn fɔ de wɔn yɛɛ nhwɛsoɔ maa wɔn a akyire yi wɔbɛyɛ amumuyɛdeɛ, 7na ɔyii Lot a ɔtene a amumuyɛfoɔ no de wɔn ahohwie abrabɔ haa no, 8#Hes 9.4 (na deɛ onipa tenenee no tenaa wɔn mu hunuiɛ na ɔteeɛ no, mmarato nnwuma no yɛɛ ne kra tenenee no ayayadeɛ daa nyinaa;) 9#1 Ko 10.13; Adi 3.10 Awurade nim sɛdeɛ ɔbɛyi wɔn a wɔde fɛreɛ som no afiri sɔhwɛ mu, na wama wɔatwe wɔn a wɔntene aso de wɔn asie atemmuo da, 10ne titire no, wɔn a wɔdi honam akyiri, efi ho akɔnnɔ mu, na wɔte tumidie atua. Wɔyɛ aniɛdenfoɔ, ahopɛfoɔ, wɔn ho mpopo sɛ wɔbɛka animuonyam ho nsɛmmɔne.
11Nanso abɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne tumi a ɛso no nka nsɛmmɔne mmu wɔn atɛn Awurade anim. 12Na yeinom deɛ, wɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔnni adwene a wɔn su ne sɛ wɔawo wɔn sɛ wɔnkyere wɔn nkum wɔn. Wɔka deɛ wɔnnim ho nsɛmmɔne, wɔbɛsɛe wɔn ara wɔn sɛeɛ mu, 13na wɔbɛnya deɛ ɛntene so akatua. Deɛ wɔbu no anigyeɛ ne daa ahohwie asetena, wɔyɛ nkekaeɛ ne dɛm, wɔde wɔn apempensie bɔ ahohwie, nanso na wɔne mo redidi, 14wɔwɔ ani a awaresɛeɛ ahyɛ no mama, a ɛrennwo wɔ bɔne ho da, wɔdaadaa akra a wɔn ase nnya ntimiiɛ, wɔwɔ akoma a aben anibereɛ mu, wɔyɛ nnomee mma, 15#Num 22.7; Adi 2.14 wɔagya ɔkwan tenenee no akɔfom kwan, wɔakɔfa Beor ba Bileam kwan no so, ɔno na na ɔpɛ deɛ ɛntene akatua, 16#Num 22.28 nanso ɔnyaa ne mmarato ho atɛnyie; afunumu a ɔntumi nkasa de onipa nne kasae sii odiyifoɔ no nkwaseasɛm no kwan.
17Yeinom yɛ mmura a nsuo nni mu, suwisie a mframa bɔ huu de rekorɔ, wɔn na wɔde esum kabikabi asie wɔn. 18Na wɔkeka akonkosɛm a hwee nni mu, nam honam akɔnnɔ mu de ahohwisɛm daadaa wɔn a wɔdwane firii wɔn a wɔbɔ nnaadaa bra no mu ɛnkyɛreeɛ. 19#Yoh 8.34 Wɔhyɛ wɔn adehyedie ho bɔ, na wɔn ara deɛ, wɔyɛ ɔporɔ nkoa, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ adi obi so nkonim no, ɛno na ɛyɛ no akoa.
20 # Mat 12.45 Na sɛ wɔnam Awurade ne Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo ho nimdeɛ so adwane wiase fi, na wɔtoatoa wɔ mu bio di nkoguo a, wɔn akyire asetena adane wɔn bɔne akyɛne kane deɛ no. 21#Luk 12.47-48 Na anka ɛyɛ ma wɔn sɛ wɔanhunu tenenee kwan no, kyɛne sɛ wɔahunu, na wɔadane afiri ahyɛdeɛ kronkron a wɔde ahyɛ wɔn no ho. 22#Mmb 26.11 Na ayɛ wɔn, sɛdeɛ nokorɛ bɛ no seɛ:
Ɔkraman asane kɔ ɔno ara ne feɛ ho bio,
na prako a wɔadware no no
asiane kɔ n’atɛkyɛ
a ɔyantam mu no mu.

Na adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ nso wɔ ɔman no mu, sɛdeɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ atorofoɔ bɛba mo mu nso. Wɔn na wɔde ɔsɛeɛ fekusɛm bɛba abɛhyɛ mu, na wɔapa Awurade a ɔtɔɔ wɔn na ɔgyee wɔn no mpo, na wɔde ɔsɛeɛ a ɛba ntɛmntɛm aba wɔn ho so. Na bebree bɛdi wɔn ahohwisɛm no akyi, na wɔn nti, wɔbɛka nokorɛ kwan no ho nsɛmmɔne. Na wɔnam anibereɛ so de nnaadaasɛm bɛpɛ mo ho mfasoɔ. Wɔn na ɛfiri tete wɔn atemmuo ntwentwɛn aseɛ, na wɔn sɛeɛ ntɔ nko.
Na sɛ Onyankopɔn ankora abɔfoɔ a wɔyɛɛ bɔne no, na mmom ɔde esum kabii ahoma kyeree wɔn guu Asamando amanehunu bunu mu, sɛ wɔmfa wɔn nsie atemmuo a, na sɛ wankora tete wiase no, na mmom Noa a ɔyɛ tenenee sɛnkafoɔ ne nnipa baason a wɔka ne ho na ɔgyee wɔn na ɔde nsuyire bɛkataa amumuyɛfoɔ wiase soɔ no, na sɛ ɔdanee Sodom ne Gomora nkuro nso, na ɔde ɔsɛeɛ buu wɔn fɔ de wɔn yɛɛ nhwɛsoɔ maa wɔn a akyire yi wɔbɛyɛ amumuyɛdeɛ, na ɔyii Lot a ɔtene a amumuyɛfoɔ no de wɔn ahohwie abrabɔ haa no, (na deɛ onipa tenenee no tenaa wɔn mu hunuiɛ na ɔteeɛ no, mmarato nnwuma no yɛɛ ne kra tenenee no ayayadeɛ daa nyinaa;) Awurade nim sɛdeɛ ɔbɛyi wɔn a wɔde fɛreɛ som no afiri sɔhwɛ mu, na wama wɔatwe wɔn a wɔntene aso de wɔn asie atemmuo da, ne titire no, wɔn a wɔdi honam akyiri, efi ho akɔnnɔ mu, na wɔte tumidie atua. Wɔyɛ aniɛdenfoɔ, ahopɛfoɔ, wɔn ho mpopo sɛ wɔbɛka animuonyam ho nsɛmmɔne.
Nanso abɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne tumi a ɛso no nka nsɛmmɔne mmu wɔn atɛn Awurade anim. Na yeinom deɛ, wɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔnni adwene a wɔn su ne sɛ wɔawo wɔn sɛ wɔnkyere wɔn nkum wɔn. Wɔka deɛ wɔnnim ho nsɛmmɔne, wɔbɛsɛe wɔn ara wɔn sɛeɛ mu, na wɔbɛnya deɛ ɛntene so akatua. Deɛ wɔbu no anigyeɛ ne daa ahohwie asetena, wɔyɛ nkekaeɛ ne dɛm, wɔde wɔn apempensie bɔ ahohwie, nanso na wɔne mo redidi, wɔwɔ ani a awaresɛeɛ ahyɛ no mama, a ɛrennwo wɔ bɔne ho da, wɔdaadaa akra a wɔn ase nnya ntimiiɛ, wɔwɔ akoma a aben anibereɛ mu, wɔyɛ nnomee mma, wɔagya ɔkwan tenenee no akɔfom kwan, wɔakɔfa Beor ba Bileam kwan no so, ɔno na na ɔpɛ deɛ ɛntene akatua, nanso ɔnyaa ne mmarato ho atɛnyie; afunumu a ɔntumi nkasa de onipa nne kasae sii odiyifoɔ no nkwaseasɛm no kwan.
Yeinom yɛ mmura a nsuo nni mu, suwisie a mframa bɔ huu de rekorɔ, wɔn na wɔde esum kabikabi asie wɔn. Na wɔkeka akonkosɛm a hwee nni mu, nam honam akɔnnɔ mu de ahohwisɛm daadaa wɔn a wɔdwane firii wɔn a wɔbɔ nnaadaa bra no mu ɛnkyɛreeɛ. Na anka ɛyɛ ma wɔn sɛ wɔanhunu tenenee kwan no, kyɛne sɛ wɔahunu, na wɔadane afiri ahyɛdeɛ kronkron a wɔde ahyɛ wɔn no ho. Na ayɛ wɔn, sɛdeɛ nokorɛ bɛ no seɛ:

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
